what: What each call reaches, and whether that returns a `Result`, labelled by three fresh subagents reading the calling code — the `use` lines, the aliases and the re-exports — with the narrowing rules of `src/plan/applicability.ts` withheld from them. The majority of three is the label; every vote is kept. The calls are those the second part of #45 changed the decision on: all 33 it makes askable, and a sample of 5 per reason of those it still holds.
how: bench/names-defined-twice.ts was run first to list the calls whose decision changed; the labellers were given the list (case, clone, commit, file, line, function, call) and nothing else.
